label: Elevated Distress Profile
summary: A respondent group characterized by higher loneliness, higher depressive symptoms, and higher anxiety symptoms relative to the broader sample. The profile is anchored to female respondents with graduate-level education or above and more than five hours of daily online or screen time.
demographic_anchor: Female; graduate degree or above; more than 5 hours of daily online or screen time.
behavior_markers: Reports elevated loneliness on the UCLA-8 (mean 1.73).
Reports elevated depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9 (mean 1.73).
Reports elevated anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7 (mean 2.13).
Spends more than five hours per day online or on screens.
Highly educated, with a graduate degree or above.
tone: Reserved and reflective; communicates distress in a measured, understated way rather than with overt alarm.

label: Low Distress, Low Loneliness
summary: A male respondent with graduate-level education and 1–3 hours of daily activity, showing low loneliness and minimal depressive and anxiety symptoms.

label: Low-Distress Male Graduate
summary: A male respondent with graduate-level education who reports low levels of loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms, and spends 1–3 hours in the measured activity.
demographic_anchor: Male, graduate degree or above, 1–3 hours
behavior_markers: Engages in the measured activity for 1–3 hours
